lines.4: 「That exchange is getting more otherworldly every time.」
lines.11: 「It's only a feeling... I'm not sure, but I keep sensing someone watching me.」
lines.13: 「How dare someone cast their clammy gaze upon what's mine. Who is it?」
lines.16: 「Yeah. If you come clean now, the worst that'll happen is every girl here hates you. So basically no change.」
lines.17: 「Didn't you just say something really cruel?」
lines.18: 「You're the one who followed Sato, right?」
lines.19: 「You guys... Have a little faith in me.」
lines.22: 「Hmm. I'd like to catch whoever it is myself, but we don't even know for sure what's happening, and I'm busy today.」
lines.23: 「So it's time for the Tsushima Family to shine.」
lines.25: 「Follow Yoppi from way behind when school lets out. Catch whoever's following her.」
lines.26: 「Got it. If it's the Princess's order.」
lines.29: 「No, no, this is nothing at all.」
lines.30: 「And there he goes, showing off again.」
lines.31: 「You don't have to come if you don't want to.」
lines.32: 「Hmph. Sounds interesting, so I'll help too.」
lines.33: 「First I need something to get into the tailing mood. I'm gonna buy an anpan from the cafeteria!」
lines.35: 「If it's some creep, leave him to me.」
lines.37: 「I won't let anyone lay a finger on you, Leo.」
lines.38: 「Quit making me sound like the one being stalked.」
lines.39: 「I feel safer with you here, Tsushima.」
lines.40: I had to live up to Sato's smile.
lines.41: 「Leo, disaster! I bought the anpan, but it looked so good I ate it on the way back! What do I do!?」
lines.48: They say dusk, the hour of meeting demons, can in some ways be more dangerous to walk alone than the middle of the night.
lines.51: From far behind, the four of us watched the swaying shrimp--Sato's hairstyle--move along.
lines.59: 「Actually... I really was the one following Yoppi.」
lines.60: 「Yeah, I can see why that'd weigh on you.」
lines.61: 「Yoppi's cute, you know? I had a moment of weakness.」
lines.62: 「I never thought it'd turn into this big a deal... Teehee.」
lines.63: 「...Summary judgment. One minute of vigilante justice.」
lines.66: 「You worthless excuse for a human being! You really are hopeless!」
lines.67: 「I was an idiot to believe you!」
lines.68: 「Gyaah! It hurts! Stop! I like bullying people weaker than me, but I hate being bullied!」
lines.69: After receiving a moderate group beating, Fukahire lay sprawled on the roadside.
lines.70: 「Seriously, why do you always pull stuff that's one step away from being criminal, Fukahire?」
lines.73: 「Let's move him to the side so he doesn't get run over... there.」
lines.75: 「So there was no culprit after all.」
lines.76: 「Yeah. In exchange for the beating, we'll keep quiet about it.」
lines.77: 「Man, I'm tired for nothing. Leo, wanna sleep together tonight?」
lines.78: There he goes with that joke again.
lines.79: Fine. I'll answer him completely straight-faced.
